svg.title: Overview of micromagnetic boundary conditions across magnetic, periodic, airbox, and mechanical domains
svg.desc: Four-panel boundary-condition summary: (a) free-surface Neumann A d_n m = 0 via FEM natural weak form and FDM clamped ghost cells; (b) Rohart-Thiaville chiral DMI boundary law 2A d_nu m + D[(n_hat x nu) x m] = 0 with exact numerically solved edge canting profile; (c) periodic BCs via FDM wrapped neighbor_index vs FEM reduced P^T A P DOF elimination; (d) FEM outer airbox Gamma_a closures (Dirichlet u = 0 vs asymptotic Robin d_n u + beta u = 0) and mechanical ElasticBody displacement constraints.
